title: Polyglot AST/indexer adapters

claim_path.grit_claim: not retried in this slice; prior ICM recall reports grit claim failed with FOREIGN KEY constraint failed

implementation_summary: Added std-only production-shaped PolyglotIndexerAdapter boundary and deterministic line-scanner adapter for Rust, TS/JS, Swift, Kotlin, C#, C/C++, WinUI/XAML, schema/contract, and config surfaces.

Normalized all extracted symbols through oya_foundry_vcs_kernel::SymbolId and ArtifactPointer, including pointer-scoped XAML bindings, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/Protobuf/schema selectors, and config selectors.
Mapped fixture dependency directives into AST-index DependencyEdge inputs and exposed PolyglotDiffMap with changed symbols, impacted symbols, impacted tests, dependency edges, and promotion blockers.
Production parser failures require explicit pointer scope and emit fallback scoped symbols; unsupported production surfaces block instead of silently admitting.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: symbol extraction normalization per language adapter
acceptance_coverage.evidence: unit corpus asserts normalized SymbolLanguage and symbol paths for Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, Swift, Kotlin, CSharp, C, C++, XAML, OpenAPI schema, and TOML config fixtures
unit and integration-style tests map a changed TypeScript route through a Tests dependency to an impacted test with no promotion blockers
unit and integration-style tests reject .elvish production surface with UnsupportedProductionSurface

acceptance_coverage.criterion: parser failure without explicit pointer blocks
acceptance_coverage.evidence: unit test rejects OYA_PARSER_FAIL production parse without explicit ArtifactPointer; explicit OpenAPI pointer admits fallback symbol
